how.title: How it works in three steps
how.lead: There is no search-and-guess step. You describe the trip once, and drivers who are free on your dates come to you with a price. Nothing is charged at any point — when you accept an offer you pay that driver directly, on the first day of the trip.

step1.title: Describe your trip once
step1.body: Dates, pick-up, how many of you and a rough route. If something is still undecided, say so — drivers will suggest alternatives rather than guess.

step2.title: Drivers send you quotes
step2.body: Your request goes to approved drivers across the island. Each offer shows the vehicle, the driver, their rating and a fixed daily rate for your itinerary.

step3.title: Chat, compare and book
step3.body: Ask questions in chat, adjust the plan, then accept the offer that fits. No card is needed — you pay your driver directly when you meet on day one.
step3.meta: No booking fee at any point

types.title: Which driver type do you need?
types.lead: Sri Lanka has three distinct roles, and booking sites use the words loosely. The difference is licensing: the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority trains and certifies chauffeur guides and national guide lecturers, while a tourist driver holds a standard driving licence. Drivers on this site submit their licence for review, and the type they hold is shown on their profile.

touristDriver.body: Holds a standard licence and drives your itinerary, handles logistics and knows where to stop, eat and stay.
touristDriver.bestFor: Beach trips, transfers and travellers who like to read up themselves

chauffeurGuideLecturer.body: Licensed by the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority, so they drive and also explain the sites you visit.
chauffeurGuideLecturer.bestFor: Most two-week itineraries — one person for the whole trip

nationalGuideLecturer.body: The highest SLTDA guiding qualification, delivering full historical and cultural interpretation.

recommended.lead: A few of the most experienced drivers on the platform. You do not have to pick one to request quotes — your request goes out island-wide either way — but it is worth seeing the kind of driver who will be answering you.

why.title: Why request through carwithdriver.lk
why.lead: We are a Sri Lankan marketplace, not an overseas reseller. Drivers list themselves, set their own prices and keep the full fare — there is no tour operator taking a cut, and the person who answers your message is the person who will meet you at arrivals.

middleman.title: You pay the driver, not a middleman
middleman.body: Drivers list themselves, set their own price and keep the full fare. There is no agency margin on top, which is why offers here land below tour-operator pricing for the same route.

locked.title: The price is locked once you accept
locked.body: Accepting an offer fixes that total for the itinerary you agreed. The rate cannot be raised afterwards, and the dates are locked to the offer.

private.title: Your details stay private
private.body: Drivers see your itinerary, not your phone number or email. Contact details are exchanged only once you accept an offer and the booking is confirmed.

licences.title: Licences are checked by our team
licences.body: Drivers submit their driving licence for admin review before their profile is approved, and the licence type they hold is shown on their profile.

reviews.title: Reviews come from real trips
reviews.body: Travellers can only review a booking they actually made through the platform, once the trip has ended.

support.title: Support based in Sri Lanka
support.body: If plans change mid-trip or a vehicle has trouble, our team is in the same time zone you are travelling in and can reach your driver directly.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.contact: Still unsure about something? Email <email>hello@carwithdriver.lk</email> or call <phone>+94 76 3021 483</phone>.

cost.q: How much does it cost to hire a car with driver in Sri Lanka?
cost.a: It depends on the vehicle and the length of your trip — drivers set their own rates. The table above is built from the live listings on this site right now, so it reflects what drivers are actually charging rather than a published price list. For a figure based on your own route and dates, use the trip cost calculator.

fee.a: No. Requesting quotes, comparing offers and chatting with drivers is completely free, and we add no booking fee or service charge on top of the driver’s price. The rate you accept is the rate you pay.

pay.q: How and when do I pay?
pay.a: You pay your driver directly when you meet on the first day of the trip — no card details are taken on this site and no deposit is charged through the platform. Agree anything unusual with your driver in chat first so it stays on record.

difference.q: What’s the difference between a tourist driver and a chauffeur guide?
difference.a: A tourist driver holds a standard licence and drives your itinerary. A chauffeur guide lecturer is licensed by the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority and may also explain the sites you visit. A national guide lecturer holds the highest SLTDA qualification and delivers full historical interpretation.

fuel.a: Nearly every listing includes fuel and insurance, and daily rates cover 120–150 km per day island-wide, which is what a driver-guided touring day usually comes to. Each offer spells out exactly what it includes, so check it before you accept.

meals.q: Are the driver’s meals and accommodation included?
meals.a: Many listings include them, but not all — it varies by driver, so it is shown on each listing and in the offer you receive. You are never asked to book a hotel room for your driver yourself; where it is included, that cost already sits inside the daily rate.

howLong.q: How long until I receive quotes?
howLong.a: Your request goes out to approved drivers as soon as you submit it, and you will get an email and a push notification for each new offer. Requests sent overnight in Sri Lanka time are usually answered the following morning.

change.q: Can I change my itinerary after booking?
change.a: Yes. Small changes on the road — swapping a beach, adding a temple, shifting a departure time — are normally fine. If a change adds driving days or a lot of distance, agree the adjusted rate with your driver in chat before you travel so it stays on record.

wrong.q: What if something goes wrong during my trip?
wrong.a: Email hello@carwithdriver.lk or call +94 76 3021 483. Every message and offer is stored, so there is always a record of what was agreed with your driver.
